detail.construction: Implement worker jobs (start time,point,natural iteration tag), finite earliest-completion selection with increasing-index tie breaking, server state (iteration,count,average accumulator,current point,worker table,clock,chosen output index/point), and explicit inactive queries. Initialization puts every worker on (x0,0) at clock0, folding zero-time dummy handshakes. Query contains worker table and active status, not tau. The event oracle alone computes next completion from hidden tau and returns worker,time,retained tag and fresh stochastic gradient at its stored point. On reply, restart that worker at the current pre-update point/tag, reject stale gradients, then update x when S current-tag gradients accumulated. After requested N updates, preserve output and clock and issue no-ops. Algorithm.Seed=Fin(N+1) with uniform PMF law; retain the selected iterate as it becomes available. Define the abstract iid minibatch recurrence separately from event execution. No theorem holes in definition bodies.
